title: Laila Duain Kijiye Jeeta Rahay Akbar
body:
Haye Haye Haye
Marne ke liye jab chale maidaan me akbar
Piche chale ghirte huwe uthte huwe sarwar
Jab dur huwa sha ha ki akho se wo dilbar
Laut aie kaha madare akbar se ye ro kar
Laila.... Laila....
<<MINI>>
Laila Duain Kijiye Jeeta Rahay Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Bete ke haq me maa ki dua radh nhi hoti...... x2
Laila Duain Kijiye
1) Rukhsat ki ghadi yaad hai tumbhi to wahi thi
akbar ke kaleje se nazar hath ti nhi thi.... x2
Laila hamare laal ka nazuk sa hai sina
Sina pe na beta mera khaie koi barchi
<<MINI>>
Laila Duain Kijiye Jeeta Rahay Akbar......
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Is baat pe shabir ka dil phat ta hai gum se
Aise toh kabhi dur na akbar hue humse.... x2
Akbar ko jeeta dekh ke hum jeete rahe hai
Akbar ko marta dekh ke mar jaienge hum bhi
<<MINI>>
Laila Duain Kijiye Jeeta Rahay Akbar......
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Mai bhool nhi paunga aisaan tumhara
Is aalame gurbat me do tum sath humara.... x2
Akbar mera jawan aur hum par hai zaieefi
Hum se toh jawa laal ki maiyaat na uthegi
<<MINI>>
Laila Duain Kijiye Jeeta Rahay Akbar......
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Ab jald dua ke liye hato ko uthalo
Aie madare akbar meri zainab ko bachalo.... x2
18 saal usne hi akbar ko hai pala
Kadiyal jawa ki lash wo na dekh sakengi
<<MINI>>
Laila Duain Kijiye Jeeta Rahay Akbar......
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Sehre ke sajane ka jo arman hai laila
Arman hi reh jaienga akbar jo na aya... x2
Akbar ko apne hath se hum dulha banae
Atharvi manat bhi toh humko hai badhani
<<MINI>>
Laila Duain Kijiye Jeeta Rahay Akbar......
<<DIVIDER>>
6) Awaz yehi aati hai sugra ki watan se
Ek baar mila de khuda bhai ko bahen se... x2
Akbar se milna paie toh mar jaiengi sugra
Maloom hai tumko meri bimar hai beti
<<MINI>>
Laila Duain Kijiye Jeeta Rahay Akbar......
<<DIVIDER>>
7) Ye kehte huwe laila ne hatho ko uthaya
Jis tarha se yakoob ko yusuf se milaya... x2
Akbar ko ek baar toh sarwar se mila de
Shabir ki ye baat mai ab suna sakungi
<<MINI>>
Laila Duain Kijiye Jeeta Rahay Akbar......
<<DIVIDER>>
8) Lauth aya jo maidan se shabir ka dilbar
Pyasa hu bohot baap se kehne lage akbar... x2
Pani... Pani ki baat aie toh rone lage maula
Khaime ki simt dekh kar awaz yehi di
<<MINI>>
Laila Duain Kijiye Jeeta Rahay Akbar......
<<DIVIDER>>
9) Zeeshan o raza wo jawan phir runko se dhara
Sine pe sine khaie toh baba ko pukara... x2
Pahuche jawa ke paas jab rote hue sarwar
Barchi yehi keh ke huwe sine se nikali
<<MINI>>
Laila Duain Kijiye Jeeta Rahay Akbar......
